pages.title: Indoor Turkey Day Hunt
pages.note: Find it, tick the box, and leave it where it was (or bring it to the hunt table if a grown-up says so). Stay out of the oven zone!

items: A photo of someone in your family
A book with an animal on the cover
A blanket you'd snuggle in after dinner
A can with a vegetable on the label
Something red that you can eat
A recipe card or a recipe on a box
A napkin folded in a fun shape
A cup that's a different color from the rest
A name card or a seat with your name
Something with a leaf on it

pages.title: Outdoor Fall Hunt
pages.note: Bring a bag for treasures you're allowed to keep. Look at feathers and critters, don't touch. Stay where a grown-up can see you.

items: A leaf bigger than your hand
An acorn (bonus: one with its cap)
A stick shaped like a letter
A feather on the ground (look, don't touch)
Smell the cold air (or a fireplace)
Hear leaves crunch under your feet

pages.title: Thankful Hunt
pages.note: No right answers here. Find each one, then tell someone what you picked and why. Grown-ups can help little ones write or draw.

items: Someone gave you as a gift
That reminds you of a friend
You'd save if you could only keep one toy
Find the oldest person here and ask their favorite Thanksgiving food
Find someone who helped cook and say thank you
Find someone who traveled the farthest today
Learn one new thing about a cousin
Give 3 high fives to 3 different people
Help set the table or clear one plate
Find someone who shares your birthday month
Make someone laugh with a joke
